value: Law No. 04/L-077 on Obligational Relationships (2012), Part VIII lease contract, Articles 585-614.
source_publisher: Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikës së Kosovës (Official Gazette of the Republic of Kosovo)
note: Albanian text of Law No. 04/L-077 on Obligational Relationships (Official Gazette No. 16/2012, 19.06.2012) as published on gzk.rks-gov.net and read on the check date.

value: Rent is paid on the dates set by the contract or law; if not agreed and there is no local practice, rent is paid every six months for leases of one or more years, or at the end of a shorter lease (Art. 600).
source_publisher: Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikës së Kosovës (Official Gazette of the Republic of Kosovo)
note: Albanian text of Law No. 04/L-077 on Obligational Relationships (Official Gazette No. 16/2012, 19.06.2012) as published on gzk.rks-gov.net and read on the check date.

value: The lessor may terminate if the tenant does not pay rent within 15 days after being called on to pay; the contract stays in force if the tenant pays before the termination notice is delivered (Art. 601).
source_publisher: Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikës së Kosovës (Official Gazette of the Republic of Kosovo)
note: Albanian text of Law No. 04/L-077 on Obligational Relationships (Official Gazette No. 16/2012, 19.06.2012) as published on gzk.rks-gov.net and read on the check date.

value: The tenant must return the property undamaged where it was handed over, but is not liable for wear from ordinary use or ageing (Art. 602).
source_publisher: Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikës së Kosovës (Official Gazette of the Republic of Kosovo)
note: Albanian text of Law No. 04/L-077 on Obligational Relationships (Official Gazette No. 16/2012, 19.06.2012) as published on gzk.rks-gov.net and read on the check date.

value: If the rented property is transferred after handover, the acquirer takes the lessor's place and cannot demand handover before the agreed lease term (or the notice period) ends (Art. 606).
source_publisher: Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikës së Kosovës (Official Gazette of the Republic of Kosovo)
note: Albanian text of Law No. 04/L-077 on Obligational Relationships (Official Gazette No. 16/2012, 19.06.2012) as published on gzk.rks-gov.net and read on the check date.

value: A fixed-term lease ends when the term expires; if the tenant keeps using the property without the lessor objecting, a new open-ended lease on the same terms is deemed concluded (Arts. 610-611).
source_publisher: Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikës së Kosovës (Official Gazette of the Republic of Kosovo)
note: Albanian text of Law No. 04/L-077 on Obligational Relationships (Official Gazette No. 16/2012, 19.06.2012) as published on gzk.rks-gov.net and read on the check date.

value: An open-ended lease ends by notice; if no notice period is set by contract, law or local custom, it is eight days. The tenant may terminate without notice if the property endangers health (Art. 612).
source_publisher: Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikës së Kosovës (Official Gazette of the Republic of Kosovo)
note: Albanian text of Law No. 04/L-077 on Obligational Relationships (Official Gazette No. 16/2012, 19.06.2012) as published on gzk.rks-gov.net and read on the check date.

value: On the death of the tenant or the lessor the lease continues with the heirs unless agreed otherwise (Art. 614).
source_publisher: Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikës së Kosovës (Official Gazette of the Republic of Kosovo)
